# Allocation
```{r EXP3_PMPD Allocation}
# 读取 Excel 文件
data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = 'Allocation')


#### 提取risky下三个情境的Gratitude/Allocation
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome_d == 'HigherOutcome',]

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome_d == 'LowerOutcome',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)

# tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'Uncertain',]
# exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)
####

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp3】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差
means <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome_raw, exp_data$Situation_raw), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome_raw, exp_data$Situation_raw), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')

```

```{r}
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(
  exp_data, dv = "Value", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome_raw","Situation_raw"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome_raw", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation_raw", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome_raw", by = "Situation_raw", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation_raw", by = "Outcome_raw", p.adjust = "bonferroni")

```

## fig-Allocation
```{r, echo=TRUE}

pt_to_mm <- 0.57
mm_to_pt <- 2.8346

width_in_inches <- 25
height_in_inches <- 25

x_start <- 0.4
bar_width <- 0.3

title_size <- 100
text_size <- 100
text_x_size <- 90
title_margin <- 35
text_margin <- 35

legend_size <- 46

sig_size <- 20
sig_ns_size <- 40
sig_seg_size <- 2

bar_linewidth <- 3

bar_fill_alpha <- 0.20
point_fill_alpha <- 0.30


# ============================================================
# 0. Output
# ============================================================
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\02_situation_diff_bar_EXP5_CMPD_260622.svg"

# ============================================================
# 1. Basic settings
# ============================================================
x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "Allocation"

outcome_levels <- c("Outcome2", "Outcome3", "Outcome4", "Outcome6", "Outcome7", "Outcome8")
outcome_labels <- c("O2", "O3", "O4", "O6", "O7", "O8")
situation_levels <- c("Uncertain", "Certain")

# ============================================================
# 2. Colors
# ============================================================
low_edge  <- "#4F81BD"
high_edge <- "#D97742"

low_fill  <- scales::alpha("#9DC3E6", bar_fill_alpha)
high_fill <- scales::alpha("#F3B082", bar_fill_alpha)

outcome_edge <- c(
  "Outcome2" = low_edge,
  "Outcome3" = low_edge,
  "Outcome4" = low_edge,
  "Outcome6" = high_edge,
  "Outcome7" = high_edge,
  "Outcome8" = high_edge
)

outcome_fill <- c(
  "Outcome2" = low_fill,
  "Outcome3" = low_fill,
  "Outcome4" = low_fill,
  "Outcome6" = high_fill,
  "Outcome7" = high_fill,
  "Outcome8" = high_fill
)

point_fill <- c(
  "Outcome2" = low_edge,
  "Outcome3" = low_edge,
  "Outcome4" = low_edge,
  "Outcome6" = high_edge,
  "Outcome7" = high_edge,
  "Outcome8" = high_edge
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Bar / point / errorbar parameters
# ============================================================
drift <- 0.2

bar_width <- 0.3
bar_edge_linewidth <- 3

errorbar_width <- 0.10
errorbar_linewidth <- 1.5

point_size <- 7
point_alpha <- 0.5
point_shape_uncertain <- 21
point_shape_certain <- 21
point_stroke <- 1
point_jitter_width <- 0.05
point_jitter_height <- 0

# ============================================================
# 4. Axis parameters
# ============================================================
y_min <- 0
y_max <- 80
y_break_by <- 20

coord_y_min <- 0
coord_y_max <- 88

x_breaks <- seq_along(outcome_levels)


# ============================================================
# 5. Manual legend parameters
# ============================================================
legend_y <- 78
legend_x1 <- 1.25
legend_x2 <- 3.65

legend_box_w <- 0.42
legend_box_h <- 4.0
legend_text_gap <- 0.2
legend_text_size <- legend_size / 2.4
legend_box_linewidth <- 1.2

legend_uncertain_fill <- "white"
legend_certain_fill <- "grey85"
legend_edge_color <- "black"

# ============================================================
# 6. Theme parameters
# ============================================================
base_font <- "Arial"

axis_linewidth <- 3

plot_margin_top <- 18
plot_margin_right <- 8
plot_margin_bottom <- 6
plot_margin_left <- 6
```


## Preprocess
```{r}

# ============================================================
# 7. Data preprocessing
# ============================================================
exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome_raw = factor(Outcome_raw, levels = outcome_levels),
    Situation_raw = factor(Situation_raw, levels = situation_levels),
    x_pos = as.numeric(Outcome_raw) +
      ifelse(Situation_raw == "Uncertain", -drift, drift),
    
    # Uncertain: 空心点 / 空心柱
    # Certain: 实心点 / 实心柱
    fill_color = ifelse(
      Situation_raw == "Uncertain",
      NA,
      outcome_fill[as.character(Outcome_raw)]
    ),
    edge_color = outcome_edge[as.character(Outcome_raw)],
    point_fill = outcome_fill[as.character(Outcome_raw)]
  )

summary_data_all <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Situation_raw, Outcome_raw) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_pos = as.numeric(Outcome_raw) +
      ifelse(Situation_raw == "Uncertain", -drift, drift),

    fill_color = ifelse(
      Situation_raw == "Uncertain",
      NA,
      outcome_fill[as.character(Outcome_raw)]
    ),
    edge_color = outcome_edge[as.character(Outcome_raw)]
  )


```


## plot
```{r}



# ============================================================
# 8. Plot
# ============================================================
p2 <- ggplot() +

  # ---------- bars ----------
  geom_col(
    data = summary_data_all,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = mean_value,
      fill = fill_color,
      color = edge_color
    ),
    width = bar_width,
    linewidth = bar_edge_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- raw points ----------
  geom_point(
    data = exp_data,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = Value,
      fill = point_fill,
      color = edge_color
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = point_size,
    stroke = point_stroke,
    alpha = point_alpha,
    # position = position_jitter(
    #   width = point_jitter_width,
    #   height = point_jitter_height
    # ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # ---------- error bars ----------
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data_all,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth
  ) +

  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_color_identity() +

  xlab(x_title) +
  ylab(y_title) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_min, y_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = outcome_labels,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))
  ) +

  # # ---------- manual legend: Uncertain ----------
  # annotate(
  #   "rect",
  #   xmin = legend_x1 - legend_box_w / 3,
  #   xmax = legend_x1 + legend_box_w,
  #   ymin = legend_y - legend_box_h / 2,
  #   ymax = legend_y + legend_box_h / 2,
  #   fill = legend_uncertain_fill,
  #   color = legend_edge_color,
  #   linewidth = legend_box_linewidth
  # ) +
  # annotate(
  #   "text",
  #   x = legend_x1 + legend_box_w + legend_text_gap,
  #   y = legend_y,
  #   label = "Uncertain",
  #   hjust = 0,
  #   size = legend_text_size
  # ) +

  # # ---------- manual legend: Certain ----------
  # annotate(
  #   "rect",
  #   xmin = legend_x2 - legend_box_w / 3,
  #   xmax = legend_x2 + legend_box_w,
  #   ymin = legend_y - legend_box_h / 2,
  #   ymax = legend_y + legend_box_h / 2,
  #   fill = legend_certain_fill,
  #   color = legend_edge_color,
  #   linewidth = legend_box_linewidth
  # ) +
  # annotate(
  #   "text",
  #   x = legend_x2 + legend_box_w + legend_text_gap,
  #   y = legend_y,
  #   label = "Certain",
  #   hjust = 0,
  #   size = legend_text_size
  # ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(coord_y_min, coord_y_max),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_family = base_font) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = title_size,
      margin = margin(t = title_margin)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = text_x_size,
      margin = margin(t = text_margin)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = title_size,
      margin = margin(r = title_margin + pt_to_mm * text_size)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = text_size,
      margin = margin(r = text_margin)
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = axis_linewidth
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      plot_margin_top,
      plot_margin_right,
      plot_margin_bottom,
      plot_margin_left
    )
  )

ggsave(
  output_path,
  plot = p2,
  width = width_in_inches,
  height = height_in_inches,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}

exp_data$Outcome_raw <- factor(exp_data$Outcome_raw, 
                        levels = c("Outcome2","Outcome3", "Outcome4","Outcome6","Outcome7","Outcome8"))
exp_data$Situation_raw <- factor(exp_data$Situation_raw, levels = c("Uncertain", "Certain"))

# 先分开处理两个组的数据
df_u <- subset(exp_data, Situation_raw == "Uncertain")
df_c <- subset(exp_data, Situation_raw == "Certain")


exp_data$x_pos = as.numeric(exp_data$Outcome_raw) + ifelse(exp_data$Situation_raw == "Uncertain", -drift, drift)

summary_data_all <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Situation_raw, Outcome_raw) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

    x_pos = as.numeric(Outcome_raw) +
      ifelse(Situation_raw == "Uncertain", -drift, drift)
  )

summary_data_all$fill_color <- NA

summary_data_all$fill_color[

] <- f_outcome_fill[

    ]
  )
]

    ]
  )
]
```
